verses.original: δὲ Ἰδὼν τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ αὐτοῦ καθίσαντος οἱ αὐτοῦ μαθηταὶ προσῆλθαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de Idōn tous ochlous anebē eis to oros kai autou kathisantos hoi autou mathētai prosēlthan autō
verses.literal: When Jesus saw the crowds He went up on the mountain and - sat down - His disciples came to Him

verses.original: καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ αὐτοῦ στόμα ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς λέγων
verses.transliteration: kai anoixas to autou stoma edidasken autous legōn
verses.literal: and He began . . . . . . . . . to teach them saying

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι Ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi ptōchoi tō pneumati Hoti autōn estin hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Blessed [are] the poor in spirit for theirs is the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες Ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi penthountes Hoti autoi paraklēthēsontai
verses.literal: Blessed [are] those who mourn for they will be comforted

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πραεῖς Ὅτι αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσιν τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi praeis Hoti autoi klēronomēsousin tēn gēn
verses.literal: Blessed [are] the meek for they will inherit the earth

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην Ὅτι αὐτοὶ χορτασθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi peinōntes kai dipsōntes tēn dikaiosynēn Hoti autoi chortasthēsontai
verses.literal: Blessed [are] those who hunger and thirst for righteousness for they will be filled

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ ἐλεήμονες Ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἐλεηθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi eleēmones Hoti autoi eleēthēsontai
verses.literal: Blessed [are] the merciful for they will be shown mercy

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ καθαροὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ Ὅτι αὐτοὶ ὄψονται τὸν Θεὸν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi katharoi tē kardia Hoti autoi opsontai ton Theon
verses.literal: Blessed [are] the pure - in heart for they will see - God

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ εἰρηνοποιοί Ὅτι αὐτοὶ κληθήσονται υἱοὶ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi eirēnopoioi Hoti autoi klēthēsontai huioi Theou
verses.literal: Blessed [are] the peacemakers for they will be called sons of God

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ δεδιωγμένοι ἕνεκεν δικαιοσύνης Ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi dediōgmenoi heneken dikaiosynēs Hoti autōn estin hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Blessed [are] those who are persecuted because of righteousness for theirs is the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: Μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν ὀνειδίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ διώξωσιν καὶ ψευδόμενοι εἴπωσιν πᾶν πονηρὸν καθ’ ὑμῶν ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Makarioi este hotan oneidisōsin hymas kai diōxōsin kai pseudomenoi eipōsin pan ponēron kath’ hymōn heneken emou
verses.literal: Blessed are you when [people] insult you - persecute [you] and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me

verses.original: χαίρετε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε ὅτι πολὺς ὁ ὑμῶν μισθὸς ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς γὰρ οὕτως ἐδίωξαν τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς πρὸ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: chairete kai agalliasthe hoti polys ho hymōn misthos en tois ouranois gar houtōs ediōxan tous prophētas tous pro hymōn
verses.literal: Rejoice and be glad because great [is] - your reward in - heaven for in the same way they persecuted the prophets - before you

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ ἅλας τῆς γῆς δὲ ἐὰν τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ ἐν τίνι ἁλισθήσεται ἰσχύει ἔτι εἰς οὐδὲν εἰ μὴ βληθὲν ἔξω καταπατεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Hymeis este to halas tēs gēs de ean to halas mōranthē en tini halisthēsetai ischyei eti eis ouden ei mē blēthen exō katapateisthai hypo tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: You are the salt of the earth But if the salt loses its savor how . . . can it be made salty again It is no longer good . . . for [anything] except . . . to be thrown out [and] trampled by - men

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου πόλις κειμένη ἐπάνω ὄρους δύναται οὐ κρυβῆναι
verses.transliteration: Hymeis este to phōs tou kosmou polis keimenē epanō orous dynatai ou krybēnai
verses.literal: You are the light of the world A city - on a hill cannot . . . be hidden

verses.original: οὐδὲ καίουσιν λύχνον καὶ τιθέασιν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν καὶ λάμπει πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ
verses.transliteration: oude kaiousin lychnon kai titheasin auton hypo ton modion all’ epi tēn lychnian kai lampei pasin tois en tē oikia
verses.literal: Neither do [people] light a lamp and put it under - a basket Instead [they set it] on - a stand and it gives light to everyone - in the house

verses.original: οὕτως τὸ ὑμῶν φῶς λαμψάτω ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὅπως ἴδωσιν ὑμῶν τὰ καλὰ ἔργα καὶ δοξάσωσιν τὸν ὑμῶν πατέρα τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: houtōs to hymōn phōs lampsatō emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn hopōs idōsin hymōn ta kala erga kai doxasōsin ton hymōn patera ton en tois ouranois
verses.literal: In the same way {let} your light shine before - men that they may see your - good deeds and glorify - your Father - in - heaven

verses.original: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον καταλῦσαι τὸν νόμον ἢ τοὺς προφήτας ἦλθον οὐκ καταλῦσαι ἀλλὰ πληρῶσαι
verses.transliteration: Mē nomisēte hoti ēlthon katalysai ton nomon ē tous prophētas ēlthon ouk katalysai alla plērōsai
verses.literal: {Do} not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets I have not come . . . to abolish [them] but to fulfill [them]

verses.original: γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀμὴν ἕως ἂν ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρέλθῃ οὐ μὴ ἓν ἰῶτα ἢ μία κεραία παρέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται
verses.transliteration: gar legō hymin amēn heōs an ho ouranos kai hē gē parelthē ou mē hen iōta ē mia keraia parelthē apo tou nomou heōs an panta genētai
verses.literal: For I tell you truly until . . . - heaven and - earth pass away not . . . a single jot not a stroke of a pen will disappear from the Law until . . . everything is accomplished

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν Ὃς λύσῃ μίαν τῶν τῶν ἐλαχίστων τούτων ἐντολῶν καὶ διδάξῃ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους οὕτως κληθήσεται ἐλάχιστος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν δ’ ὃς ἂν ποιήσῃ καὶ διδάξῃ οὗτος κληθήσεται μέγας ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: ean oun Hos lysē mian tōn tōn elachistōn toutōn entolōn kai didaxē tous anthrōpous houtōs klēthēsetai elachistos en tē basileia tōn ouranōn d’ hos an poiēsē kai didaxē houtos klēthēsetai megas en tē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: vvv So then whoever breaks one of the - least of these commandments and teaches - others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven but whoever . . . practices and teaches [them] - will be called great in the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ ὑμῶν ἡ δικαιοσύνη περισσεύσῃ πλεῖον τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων εἰσέλθητε οὐ μὴ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: gar legō hymin hoti ean mē hymōn hē dikaiosynē perisseusē pleion tōn grammateōn kai Pharisaiōn eiselthēte ou mē eis tēn basileian tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: For I tell you that unless . . . your - righteousness exceeds . . . [that] of the scribes and Pharisees you will never enter . . . . . . . . . the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις φονεύσεις Οὐ δ’ ὃς ἂν φονεύσῃ ἔσται ἔνοχος τῇ κρίσει
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē tois archaiois phoneuseis Ou d’ hos an phoneusē estai enochos tē krisei
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said to the ancients Do not murder . . . and Anyone who . . . murders will be subject to judgment

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὀργιζόμενος τῷ αὐτοῦ ἀδελφῷ ἔσται ἔνοχος τῇ κρίσει δ’ ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ αὐτοῦ ἀδελφῷ Ῥακά ἔσται ἔνοχος τῷ συνεδρίῳ δ’ ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ Μωρέ ἔσται ἔνοχος εἰς τὴν τοῦ πυρός γέενναν
verses.transliteration: de egō legō hymin hoti pas ho orgizomenos tō autou adelphō estai enochos tē krisei d’ hos an eipē tō autou adelphō Rhaka estai enochos tō synedriō d’ hos an eipē Mōre estai enochos eis tēn tou pyros geennan
verses.literal: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with - his brother will be subject to judgment Again anyone who . . . says to his brother Raca will be subject to the Sanhedrin But anyone who . . . says You fool will be subject to the - fire of hell

verses.original: οὖν Ἐὰν προσφέρῃς τὸ σου δῶρόν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κἀκεῖ μνησθῇς ὅτι ὁ σου ἀδελφός ἔχει τι κατὰ σοῦ
verses.transliteration: oun Ean prospherēs to sou dōron epi to thysiastērion kakei mnēsthēs hoti ho sou adelphos echei ti kata sou
verses.literal: So if you are offering - your gift at the altar and there remember that - your brother has something against you

verses.original: ἄφες τὸ σου δῶρόν ἐκεῖ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ πρῶτον ὕπαγε διαλλάγηθι τῷ σου ἀδελφῷ καὶ τότε ἐλθὼν πρόσφερε τὸ σου δῶρόν
verses.transliteration: aphes to sou dōron ekei emprosthen tou thysiastēriou kai prōton hypage diallagēthi tō sou adelphō kai tote elthōn prosphere to sou dōron
verses.literal: leave - your gift there before the altar - First go [and] be reconciled to your brother - then come [and] offer - your gift

verses.original: ἴσθι εὐνοῶν ταχὺ μετ’ αὐτοῦ τῷ σου ἀντιδίκῳ ἕως ὅτου εἶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ μή‿ ποτέ ὁ ἀντίδικος παραδῷ σε τῷ κριτῇ καὶ ὁ κριτὴς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ καὶ βληθήσῃ εἰς φυλακὴν
verses.transliteration: Isthi eunoōn tachy met’ autou tō sou antidikō heōs hotou ei en tē hodō mē pote ho antidikos paradō se tō kritē kai ho kritēs tō hypēretē kai blēthēsē eis phylakēn
verses.literal: vvv Reconcile quickly - - with your adversary while . . . you are still on the way [to court] Otherwise . . . - [he] may hand you over . . . to the judge and the judge [may hand you over] to the officer and you may be thrown into prison

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω σοι οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως ἂν ἀποδῷς τὸν ἔσχατον κοδράντην
verses.transliteration: amēn legō soi ou mē exelthēs ekeithen heōs an apodōs ton eschaton kodrantēn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you vvv vvv you will not get out - until . . . you have paid the last penny

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη μοιχεύσεις Οὐ
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē moicheuseis Ou
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said Do not commit adultery . . .

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ βλέπων γυναῖκα πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι αὐτὴν ἤδη ἐμοίχευσεν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ αὐτοῦ καρδίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de egō legō hymin hoti pas ho blepōn gynaika pros to epithymēsai autēn ēdē emoicheusen autēn en tē autou kardia
verses.literal: But I tell you that anyone - who looks at a woman to - lust after her {has} already committed adultery with her in - his heart

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ὁ σου ὁ δεξιὸς ὀφθαλμός σκανδαλίζει σε ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ γάρ συμφέρει σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν σου μελῶν καὶ μὴ σου ὅλον τὸ σῶμά βληθῇ εἰς γέενναν
verses.transliteration: de ei ho sou ho dexios ophthalmos skandalizei se exele auton kai bale apo sou gar sympherei soi hina apolētai hen tōn sou melōn kai mē sou holon to sōma blēthē eis geennan
verses.literal: - If - your - right eye causes you to sin . . . gouge it out . . . and throw [it] away . . . - It is better for you to lose one vvv vvv part of your body [than for] . . . your whole - body to be thrown into hell

verses.original: καὶ εἰ ἡ σου δεξιά χεὶρ σκανδαλίζει σε ἔκκοψον αὐτὴν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ γάρ συμφέρει σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν σου μελῶν καὶ μὴ σου ὅλον τὸ σῶμά ἀπέλθῃ εἰς γέενναν
verses.transliteration: kai ei hē sou dexia cheir skandalizei se ekkopson autēn kai bale apo sou gar sympherei soi hina apolētai hen tōn sou melōn kai mē sou holon to sōma apelthē eis geennan
verses.literal: And if - your right hand causes you to sin . . . cut it off . . . and throw [it] away . . . - It is better for you to lose one vvv vvv part of your body [than for] . . . your whole - body to depart into hell

verses.original: Ἐρρέθη δέ Ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα δότω αὐτῇ ἀποστάσιον
verses.transliteration: Errethē de Hos an apolysē tēn autou gynaika dotō autē apostasion
verses.literal: It has also been said . . . Whoever . . . divorces - his wife must give her a certificate of divorce

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ἀπολύων τὴν αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα παρεκτὸς λόγου πορνείας ποιεῖ μοιχευθῆναι αὐτὴν καὶ ὃς ἐὰν γαμήσῃ ἀπολελυμένην μοιχᾶται
verses.transliteration: de egō legō hymin hoti pas ho apolyōn tēn autou gynaika parektos logou porneias poiei moicheuthēnai autēn kai hos ean gamēsē apolelymenēn moichatai
verses.literal: But I tell you that anyone - who divorces - his wife except for sexual immorality brings adultery upon her And he who . . . marries a divorced woman commits adultery

verses.original: Πάλιν ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις ἐπιορκήσεις Οὐκ δὲ ἀποδώσεις τοὺς σου ὅρκους τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Palin ēkousate hoti errethē tois archaiois epiorkēseis Ouk de apodōseis tous sou horkous tō Kyriō
verses.literal: Again you have heard that it was said to the ancients Do not break your oath . . . but fulfill - your vows to the Lord

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ὀμόσαι ὅλως μήτε ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὅτι ἐστὶν τοῦ Θεοῦ θρόνος
verses.transliteration: de egō legō hymin mē omosai holōs mēte en tō ouranō hoti estin tou Theou thronos
verses.literal: But I tell you not to swear at all [either] by - heaven for it is - God’s throne

verses.original: μήτε ἐν τῇ γῇ ὅτι ἐστιν ὑποπόδιόν τῶν αὐτοῦ ποδῶν μήτε εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ὅτι ἐστὶν πόλις τοῦ μεγάλου Βασιλέως
verses.transliteration: mēte en tē gē hoti estin hypopodion tōn autou podōn mēte eis Hierosolyma hoti estin polis tou megalou Basileōs
verses.literal: [or] by the earth for it is His footstool . . . . . . . . . [or] by Jerusalem for it is [the] city of the great King

verses.original: μήτε ὀμόσῃς ἐν τῇ σου κεφαλῇ ὅτι δύνασαι οὐ ποιῆσαι μίαν τρίχα λευκὴν ἢ μέλαιναν
verses.transliteration: mēte omosēs en tē sou kephalē hoti dynasai ou poiēsai mian tricha leukēn ē melainan
verses.literal: Nor should you swear by - your head for you cannot . . . make a single hair white or black

verses.original: δὲ ἔστω ὁ ὑμῶν λόγος Ναὶ ναί οὒ Οὔ τὸ δὲ περισσὸν τούτων ἐστιν ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: de estō ho hymōn logos Nai nai ou Ou to de perisson toutōn estin ek tou ponērou
verses.literal: Simply let - your - Yes [be] ‘Yes [and your] ‘No No Anything . . . more . . . comes from the evil [one]

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Ὀφθαλμὸν ἀντὶ ὀφθαλμοῦ καὶ ὀδόντα ἀντὶ ὀδόντος
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē Ophthalmon anti ophthalmou kai odonta anti odontos
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said Eye for eye and tooth for tooth

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ἀντιστῆναι τῷ πονηρῷ ἀλλ’ ὅστις ῥαπίζει σε εἰς τὴν σου δεξιὰν σιαγόνα στρέψον αὐτῷ τὴν ἄλλην καὶ
verses.transliteration: de egō legō hymin mē antistēnai tō ponērō all’ hostis rhapizei se eis tēn sou dexian siagona strepson autō tēn allēn kai
verses.literal: But I tell you not to resist an evil [person] - [If] someone slaps you on - your right cheek turn to him the other also

verses.original: καὶ τῷ θέλοντί κριθῆναι σοι καὶ λαβεῖν τὸν σου χιτῶνά ἄφες αὐτῷ τὸ ἱμάτιον καὶ
verses.transliteration: kai tō thelonti krithēnai soi kai labein ton sou chitōna aphes autō to himation kai
verses.literal: - if someone wants to sue you and take - your tunic let him have . . . [your] cloak as well

verses.original: καὶ ὅστις ἀγγαρεύσει σε ἕν μίλιον ὕπαγε μετ’ αὐτοῦ δύο
verses.transliteration: kai hostis angareusei se hen milion hypage met’ autou dyo
verses.literal: and if someone forces you to go . . . one mile go with him two [miles]

verses.original: δός τῷ αἰτοῦντί σε καὶ ἀποστραφῇς μὴ τὸν θέλοντα δανίσασθαι ἀπὸ σοῦ
verses.transliteration: dos tō aitounti se kai apostraphēs mē ton thelonta danisasthai apo sou
verses.literal: Give to the [one] who asks you and do not turn away from . . . the [one] who wants to borrow from you

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν σου πλησίον καὶ μισήσεις τὸν σου ἐχθρόν
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē Agapēseis ton sou plēsion kai misēseis ton sou echthron
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said Love - your neighbor and Hate - your enemy

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ὑμῶν ἐχθροὺς καὶ προσεύχεσθε ὑπὲρ τῶν διωκόντων ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de egō legō hymin agapate tous hymōn echthrous kai proseuchesthe hyper tōn diōkontōn hymas
verses.literal: But I tell you love - your enemies and pray for those who persecute you

verses.original: ὅπως γένησθε υἱοὶ τοῦ ὑμῶν Πατρὸς τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς ὅτι ἀνατέλλει τὸν αὐτοῦ ἥλιον ἐπὶ πονηροὺς καὶ ἀγαθοὺς καὶ βρέχει ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ ἀδίκους
verses.transliteration: hopōs genēsthe huioi tou hymōn Patros tou en ouranois hoti anatellei ton autou hēlion epi ponērous kai agathous kai brechei epi dikaious kai adikous
verses.literal: that you may be sons of your Father - in heaven - He causes - His sun {to rise} on [the] evil and [the] good and sends rain on [the] righteous and [the] unrighteous

verses.original: γὰρ ἐὰν ἀγαπήσητε τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ὑμᾶς τίνα μισθὸν ἔχετε οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ τελῶναι ποιοῦσιν τὸ αὐτὸ
verses.transliteration: gar ean agapēsēte tous agapōntas hymas tina misthon echete ouchi kai hoi telōnai poiousin to auto
verses.literal: - If you love those who love you what reward will you get Do not even - tax collectors do the same

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἀσπάσησθε μόνον τοὺς ὑμῶν ἀδελφοὺς τί ποιεῖτε περισσὸν οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ ἐθνικοὶ ποιοῦσιν τὸ αὐτὸ
verses.transliteration: kai ean aspasēsthe monon tous hymōn adelphous ti poieite perisson ouchi kai hoi ethnikoi poiousin to auto
verses.literal: And if you greet only - your brothers what are you doing more than others Do not even - Gentiles do the same

verses.original: Ἔσεσθε ὑμεῖς τέλειοι οὖν ὡς ὁ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος Πατὴρ ἐστιν τέλειός
verses.transliteration: Esesthe hymeis teleioi oun hōs ho hymōn ho ouranios Patēr estin teleios
verses.literal: Be - perfect therefore as - your - heavenly Father is perfect
